correctness.rationale: Weighted forest rank is exactly support matching number by unique determinant monomial in a chosen maximum matching minor. A cycle with shared row deleted becomes a weighted path; a two-state transfer recurrence produces P_n. An intersection-dimension identity counts Q_n rank-neutral root rows; single-cycle determinant cancellation gives S_n, hence Q_n=(S_n-q^2zP_n)/(1-z). Gluing two paths on disjoint column coordinates makes the rank-neutral condition conjunctive, proving W=q^4zP_nP_m+(1-z)Q_nQ_m. Full-support defect requires simultaneous cancellation of two independent alternating determinant products. Radical-square-zero Jordan strata are determined exactly by rank. Reconstructed symbolic identities and brute-force direct Gaussian elimination over q=2,3,4,5 match all listed cases, with independent total-mass checks.

originality.rationale: Closest published single-cycle and tree formulas are acknowledged as covering their individual components. The new claim is an explicit cut-vertex rank-gluing formula using shared-row rowspace intersections, yielding all rank/Jordan strata for two even cycles meeting at one vertex. The 2022 unrestricted triangular-matrix census and prior graphical-group cycle/tree rank results do not directly imply the wedge coefficients; searches using rank, Jordan, incidence, cut-vertex and bipartite cactus aliases found no dominating result. Historical priority is not guaranteed, especially given generic gluing identities in older enumerative linear algebra.
residual_risks: A general older finite-field sparse-matrix rank-gluing theorem might imply the rooted identity and wedge formula, even if not indexed by the searches.
One-cycle rank formula and forest matching-rank lemma are prior results and are not new; their use as ingredients must not be misread as independent novelty.
No external independent mathematical review has been performed.

value.rationale: Provides a complete natural, parameter-uniform rank and Jordan-type census for bipartite support consisting of two even cycles joined at one vertex (first articulation-coupled bicyclic case) rather than a single graph instance. It isolates a nontrivial simultaneous cancellation and sharp full-support rank defect at q=2, and supplies a reusable rooted rowspace gluing law not present in the closest inspected cycle/tree results. The coefficients count radicals in a natural infinite family of height-two incidence algebras, not an arbitrary slice. The existence of generic related linear-algebra principles is acknowledged.
